title: Release Evidence Bundle (Trust Binder)
description: Machine-readable proof that a set of release artifacts came from commit X AND passed gate-set G at time T. One instance per release tag. Designed to be signed as a detached cosign blob AND/OR wrapped as an in-toto predicate tied to the existing SLSA provenance.

predicate_type.description: in-toto predicateType URI when this bundle is embedded as a statement predicate.

bundle_id.description: Stable id for this evidence bundle, e.g. <repo>@<tag>.

source_uri.description: git+https URI, matches the SLSA provenance --source-uri.

tag.description: Release tag, e.g. skillctl/v0.5.0 or v1.2.0.

channel.description: Which release workflow produced these artifacts.

artifact_digests.description: One entry per published binary/asset. Mirrors the in-toto subject shape so this list can be reused as the statement subjects.

produced_at.description: T — when this bundle was assembled (UTC, RFC3339).

generated_by.description: What assembled the bundle (for reproducibility / non-repudiation).

workflow_run.description: URL of the CI run that assembled the bundle.

policy.description: The ruleset that decides which gates are required and what enterprise_ready means. A verifier re-evaluates enterprise_ready against a named policy rather than trusting the stored bool.

gates.description: Gate-set G. Order is presentational; identity is `id`.

name.description: Human label; SHOULD match the CI job name so a consumer can find it in the run.

required.description: Whether this gate counts toward enterprise_ready under `policy`.

evidence_ref.description: URL to the concrete evidence: a CI run/job, a release asset, or an attestation. This is the human/audit landing point.

evidence_type.description: Shape of evidence_ref, so a consumer knows whether it is re-verifiable (attestation/asset) or a pointer (ci-log).

verifiability.description: re-verify: an offline consumer can cryptographically re-check (cosign bundle, SLSA provenance, SBOM digest). reference: points at signed-elsewhere evidence. trust-ci: only a CI-run log attests it (pass/fail is asserted, not re-provable offline).

references.description: Aggregate evidence artifacts this bundle POINTS AT (does not re-embed). Lets a verifier fetch + re-verify without re-listing per-gate.

sha256.description: Digest of the referenced artifact, so the pointer is itself tamper-evident.

enterprise_ready.description: Convenience bool = (required_failed == 0 AND every required gate status==pass) under `policy`. A strict verifier RECOMPUTES this from `gates` + its own policy rather than trusting the stored value.

caveats.description: Gates that a stricter enterprise policy would demand but are currently required:false (e.g. gosec, threat-model-delta).
